title: Replaces the old part at the specified position in the queue
goal: Use splice to simultaneously delete an item and insert a new item in its original position.
summary: replaces a record in the equipment distribution table, and the front and rear members still retain their original positions.
tasks: completes swapDevice(devices, index, replacement), and the valid numerical subscript corresponds to a record that needs to be replaced.
allows direct modification of devices and returns the entire adjusted array. When the subscript is out of bounds, it is returned unchanged.

example.note: splice is the number of deletions, and the subsequent parameters are the new values inserted at the deleted positions.

hint: uses index < 0 or index >= devices.length to determine out of bounds. splice returns the deleted items.
